title: Tirunelveli Visual Prompt Template
subject: A photorealistic, cinematic view of the natural beauty and everyday rural life of Tirunelveli district, Tamil Nadu, India: the Thamirabarani river flowing past green paddy fields, palmyra trees, and the distant Western Ghats, with a small number of local residents in the landscape.

setting.place: Thamirabarani riverbank near Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu, India
setting.region_details: Southern Tamil Nadu; fertile river plains, paddy fields, palmyra palms, and the Western Ghats visible in the distance
setting.era: Present day, with traditional rural Tamil details
setting.architecture: A few modest traditional Tamil village houses in the far background, with tiled roofs and limewashed walls
setting.textiles: If people are visible, dress them in everyday South Tamil Nadu clothing such as simple cotton sarees and veshti, not costume-like clothing

lighting: Soft, natural early-morning sunlight with gentle mist over the river and fields; realistic shadows and natural highlights

camera.composition: The river leads the eye through the foreground toward paddy fields, palmyra trees, and the distant hills; realistic scale and uncluttered framing

style: Photorealistic travel photography, cinematic but natural, culturally grounded, fine environmental detail, realistic colours, no exaggerated saturation
avoid: religious places, buildings, monuments, symbols, ceremonies, or worship
temples, mosques, churches, shrines, and religious landmarks
generic or inaccurate Indian stereotypes and costume-like clothing
unrelated locations or landscapes outside Tirunelveli district
modern high-rise skylines, fantasy scenery, or artificial architecture
oversaturated colours, excessive HDR, plastic-looking textures
text, captions, watermarks, logos, borders, or UI elements
distorted people, extra limbs, duplicated objects, or malformed hands

motion.subject_motion: The river flows gently, paddy leaves and palmyra fronds sway slightly in a light breeze, and distant birds move naturally across the sky
motion.camera_move: A slow, smooth cinematic forward dolly along the riverbank, keeping the landscape stable and natural
